Fossil delta vectors: each directory holds an `origin`, a `target`, and the
`delta` Fossil itself produced between them (`fossil test-delta-create`).
Copied unchanged from centrifugal/fdelta at commit
9e224621660280b6ab1c3fc2931cedabd26e0a87, `testdata/fossil-vectors/`, under
the BSD 2-Clause license in `LICENSE`. Used by `src/fossil.rs`'s tests
(Block 19, D9).
